normal.name: ja2ui0
normal.text: When I discuss video #games with people, the predictable features that surface are graphics, genre busting mechanics, and for me, retro sensibilities (having grown up in the 80s). The scores / #soundtrack of video games have more to do with the feelings we associate with them and our overall experiences than anything else. Koji Kondo, Nobuo Uematsu and C418, for some examples, have been #instrumental in my own development since long before I knew their names. Who are yours?

normal.text: Does a bad ending ruin a great game? Todd Oxtra of The Fandom Foundry says it doesn’t. On the Boss Rush Podcast, Todd asks how many endings are actually great, pointing out that plenty of movies, comics, and TV series fumble the landing. For him it’s the journey, not the destination, and the decisions he made along the way are what resonated. #BioWare #RPG #GameEndings #GamingOpinion #BossRushPodcast
